title: Statistics on Yau's conjecture: Variance asymptotics
summary: We investigate the probabilistic counterpart of Yau's conjecture on the nodal volume of Laplace eigenfunctions on compact manifolds, by studying the high-frequency variance asymptotics of Riemannian random waves. We establish (Theorem A) a quantitative bound for the fluctuations of their nodal volumes, depending on different regimes of spectral windows, including the monochromatic one, of spectral size 1. Notably, our bounds improve, by more than a power 2, the existing results in the literature, cf. Canzani and Hanin (2020), in the case of manifolds without conjugate points, in particular…
